grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。
title: A Busy Saturday
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。这是一个模拟练习，不是官方考试。请仔细阅读短文，并根据短文内容选择或填写答案。
passage: Last Saturday, Li Ming was very busy. He was at home in the morning. He cleaned his room because it was dirty. Then he was hungry, so he cooked noodles. In the afternoon, he was at the library. He read a book about cars because he likes cars. He was there for two hours. In the evening, he was tired. He watched TV with his sister. They were happy. Now Li Ming is going to visit his grandmother next Sunday. He is going to take a bus because her house is far. He is going to buy some fruit for her. He is going to stay there for three hours. He is going to have dinner with her. He is going to come back at 8 p.m.

questions.prompt: 上周六上午李明在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文中说“He was at home in the morning.”，所以上午他在家。
questions.evidence: He was at home in the morning.

questions.explanation: 短文中说“He cleaned his room because it was dirty.”，所以是因为房间脏了。
questions.evidence: He cleaned his room because it was dirty.

questions.explanation: 短文中说“In the afternoon, he was at the library.”，所以下午他在图书馆。
questions.evidence: In the afternoon, he was at the library.

questions.prompt: 李明在图书馆待了多久？
questions.explanation: 短文中说“He was there for two hours.”，所以是两小时。
questions.evidence: He was there for two hours.

questions.prompt: 李明为什么读关于汽车的书？
questions.explanation: 短文中说“He read a book about cars because he likes cars.”，所以是因为他喜欢汽车。
questions.evidence: He read a book about cars because he likes cars.

questions.prompt: 李明晚上和谁一起看电视？请用短文中的词填空。
questions.explanation: 短文中说“He watched TV with his sister.”，所以是和他的妹妹一起。
questions.evidence: He watched TV with his sister.

questions.prompt: 李明下周日打算做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文中说“Now Li Ming is going to visit his grandmother next Sunday.”，所以是去看望奶奶。
questions.evidence: Now Li Ming is going to visit his grandmother next Sunday.

questions.prompt: 李明为什么打算坐公交车？
questions.explanation: 短文中说“He is going to take a bus because her house is far.”，所以是因为奶奶家很远。
questions.evidence: He is going to take a bus because her house is far.

grammar.title: 过去时与将来计划
grammar.explanation: 我们用 was 和 were 表示过去的状况。was 用于 I, he, she, it；were 用于 you, we, they。我们用 be going to 表示计划或打算。because 用来表示原因。
grammar.example: He was at home in the morning. He is going to visit his grandmother next Sunday.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：I ___ at school yesterday.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，过去时用 was。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：They ___ happy last night.
questions.explanation: 主语是 They，过去时用 were。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：She ___ going to buy a book tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 主语是 She，be going to 用 is。
questions.evidence: She is going to buy a book tomorrow.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：We ___ going to play football next week.
questions.explanation: 主语是 We，be going to 用 are。
questions.evidence: We are going to play football next week.

part1: What did you do last weekend?
Are you going to do anything special next week?
Do you like to read books? Why?
How do you usually go to school or work?
speaking.part2: Describe a busy day you had recently. You should say: when it was, what you did, why you were busy, and how you felt.
part3: Do you often make plans for the weekend?
What do you usually do when you are tired?
Do you think it is important to visit family? Why?
How do you go to places that are far away?

transfer.writing: Write 5 sentences about what you did last weekend and what you are going to do next weekend. Use was/were and be going to.
